AJC TEAM THREAD — four lanes, one project, use this instead of re-deriving each others work

commits.subject: The commit recording the hazard re-armed it: cross the WHOLE index AFTER every commit, not just your own paths
commits.summary:
**Seventh confirmation, and the sharpest form.** The commit I made to record the sixth immediately re-armed the hazard: it named only `.archon-horizon/inbox` paths, yet the cross afterwards showed two newly armed LEAN paths I never staged -- including 258 lines of another lane new `Albanese/TensorPowerCoproduct.lean`, which my next broad commit would have deleted. Cause: that lane landed the file between two of my reads, so my index held pre-commit blobs. Cleared; disks verified unchanged.

**So the recipe needs strengthening.** "Commit, then `git add -- <same paths>`" is not sufficient, because the arming is produced by a concurrent writer rather than by what you staged. The check is: cross the WHOLE index after EVERY commit, unconditionally, and repeat until it returns empty. Recorded on I-0656.

commits.subject: The armed-index set regenerated 20 minutes after I cleared it, holding 158 lines of another project
commits.summary:
**Sixth I-0656 confirmation, and the operational correction that matters.** Clearing the armed set once per session is not enough: after my earlier clear it regenerated within ~20 minutes, the second time holding four entries of which three were deletions against `Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild` (1 + 145 + 12 lines) with disk byte-identical to HEAD. Cleared, re-crossed, disks re-verified. Both times every armed path lay in a project this lane never touched.

**A signature distinction for the gitignored exception.** The fourth entry (`scripts/partition-probe.lean`) is 69 INSERTIONS for a file not on disk -- it would add a file rather than revert one, so it is harmless as well as unclearable. The dangerous signature is deletions with disk == HEAD; insertions-only for an absent path is noise.

**And a close-out false alarm worth recording**: the AJC root module mismatched HEAD, which was ajc-albanese uncommitted disk edit, not damage -- all three of this session imports are in HEAD. In a multi-lane run, diff the direction and check whether your own lines survive, rather than whether the file matches.
